subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should this PR require live Gateway memory_search outage/recovery proof before merge, or is a maintainer proof override acceptable for this memory-core fallback fix?
rationale: The code path appears correct from source review, but the contributor-provided evidence is still mock-only for a user-facing provider outage/recovery workflow.

options.title: Require live Gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output, logs, a linked artifact, or a recording showing outage, fallback activation, primary recovery, and after-recovery memory_search results before merge.

options.title: Override proof requirement
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the deterministic manager regression as sufficient and own the missing live-provider proof risk.

recommendation.title: Require live Gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal/live output, logs, a linked artifact, or a recording showing outage, fallback activation, primary recovery, and after-recovery memory_search results before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The provider-state and memory engine history makes this the best available owner for judging proof sufficiency on the fallback recovery path.
